sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-01)
sweep.text: Every NPC in Skyrim, Update, Dawnguard, HearthFires, Dragonborn and the CC packs whose race carries the `Vampire` keyword 0A82BB or is a gargoyle or death hound race, followed through every template and `LVLN`; then every NPC named or edited as a vampire or thrall; then every quest alias that renames a placed ref of them. Alva (`NordRace`, a vampire by her abilities) was added by hand on 2026-10-05. Everything found is on a family page except the following.
